 Good in Fatty liver.

fullContent:
Vyoshadi Guggulu 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridaya Chikitsa Sthana 29/49-54 
 Introduction 
 Vyoshadi Guggulu is an ayurvedic preparation that maintains the balance of Vata and Kapha Dosha. It is anti-obesity, anti-rheumatic, anti–inflammatory and anti–hyperlipidemic. It is widely used as ayurvedic treatment for obesity and can even lessen rheumatism and rheumatoid disease. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Trikatu – Ginger, Pepper and Long pepper 
 Chitrak ( Plumbago zeylancia ) 
 Musta ( Cyperus rotundus ) 
 Vidanga ( Embelia ribes ) 
 Triphala – Haritaki ( Terminalia chebula ), Vibhitaki ( Terminalia bellerica ), Amla ( Emblica officinalis ) 
 Guggulu – Purified Commiphora mukul . 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients including Trikatu, chitrak, Musta, Vidanga, Triphala are powdered with Guggulu and then rolled into tablet form of uniform size of around 500 mg. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 1-2 tablets 2-3 times a day, before or after having meals or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor. 
 Administered usually along with cow urine, honey or warm water. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Wisely used Ayurvedic treatment of obesity, hypercholesterolemia, rheumatoid arthritis. 
 It is helpful to decrease bad cholesterol (LDL) and increase good cholesterol (HDL). 
 It improves digestion and appetite. 
 It provides relief from symptoms of disorders like joint swelling, arthritis, gout, bloating, gas, distension etc. 
 Due to its warming effects it helps to improve metabolism. 
 Good in Fatty liver. 
 Controls and improves better bowel movements. 
 Removes obstruction from channels and removes congestion. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 It is better to use this product under medical supervision. 
 Self-medication with this medicine is discouraged. 
 Very high dose than prescribed may lead to stomach irritation. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
